::: {#rem-monte-carlo-se-estimate}
#### Reporting a Monte Carlo standard error

The standard deviation $\SD{T}$ in @thm-monte-carlo-se is unknown,
so a study reports the [sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd) $s_T$ of the estimates $T_1, \ldots, T_M$
divided by $\sqrt{M}$ in its place.
The Monte Carlo standard error shrinks like $1 / \sqrt{M}$,
so quadrupling the number of replications halves it.
A simulation estimate should be reported with its Monte Carlo standard error,
so a reader can tell a real difference from simulation noise.
:::
